name: deident-wasm
tagline: Privacy engine that de-identifies datasets in WASM
description: deident-wasm is a privacy and anonymization engine compiled to WebAssembly. It performs pseudonymization and risk-assessed de-identification on datasets, with a design aimed at GDPR and HIPAA compliance workflows. Running in WASM means the sensitive data never has to leave the browser or the local environment, making it a practical fit for privacy-preserving data pipelines and client-side redaction tooling.
highlights: Pseudonymization and risk-assessed de-identification in one engine
Compiled to WebAssembly so data can stay on-device
Built around GDPR and HIPAA compliance requirements
Rust core with a portable WASM interface
curatorNote: De-identification is usually a server-side database chore. Doing it in WASM keeps the data local, which is exactly the right call for privacy-sensitive pipelines — and a neat fit for client-side tooling.
